// CsWin32 generates P/Invoke for exactly the names listed here, from the
// official Win32 metadata. Keep this list tight: every entry is code generated
// into the AOT binary.
//
// Display ENUMERATION lives in DispCtrl.Core, which both processes share. What is
// left here is window and taskbar manipulation, which only the engine does.

// ---- taskbar window manipulation ----
FindWindowEx
IsWindow
GetWindowRect
GetCursorPos
SetWindowPos
SET_WINDOW_POS_FLAGS
GetForegroundWindow
GetClassName
SystemParametersInfo
SYSTEM_PARAMETERS_INFO_ACTION
SYSTEM_PARAMETERS_INFO_UPDATE_FLAGS

// ---- work-area lookup for a managed bar's monitor ----
MonitorFromPoint
GetMonitorInfo

// ---- DPI ----
SetProcessDpiAwarenessContext
DPI_AWARENESS_CONTEXT

// ---- console attach ----
// The engine is a WinExe so it shows no window when autostarted; it attaches to
// the parent console only when a CLI command is actually run from one.
AttachConsole

// ---- timer resolution ----
// Held only while a slide is in flight; a 1ms system timer at rest would be a
// pointless power cost on a laptop.
timeBeginPeriod
timeEndPeriod

// ---- per-app presets ----
// Which app is in front, polled once a second. A WinEvent hook would put this
// process in the message path of every activation on the machine; two syscalls
// on a timer cannot slow anything else down.
GetWindowThreadProcessId

// ---- Windows' own night light ----
// Its state lives in a registry value, and polling for it would make a toggle
// pressed in Quick Settings take up to a tick to show here. The key signals
// instead, so the two switches move together.
RegNotifyChangeKeyValue
REG_NOTIFY_FILTER

// ---- global hotkeys ----
// WM_HOTKEY goes to the queue of the thread that registered it, and the engine
// polls rather than pumping, so the hotkey service owns a thread of its own.
RegisterHotKey
UnregisterHotKey
GetMessage
PostThreadMessage
GetCurrentThreadId
MSG
HOT_KEY_MODIFIERS
WM_HOTKEY
WM_APP
WM_QUIT

// ---- tray icon ----
// The panel is summoned from the notification area, which needs a real window
// to receive the callback: Shell_NotifyIcon posts to an HWND, not to a thread.
// Hidden and top-level rather than message-only, because Explorer restarting
// broadcasts TaskbarCreated and a message-only window does not hear broadcasts.
Shell_NotifyIcon
NOTIFYICONDATAW
NOTIFY_ICON_MESSAGE
NOTIFY_ICON_DATA_FLAGS
RegisterClassEx
UnregisterClass
WNDCLASSEXW
CreateWindowEx
DestroyWindow
DefWindowProc
DispatchMessage
TranslateMessage
RegisterWindowMessage
GetModuleHandle
ExtractIconEx
DestroyIcon
PostMessage
SetForegroundWindow
WINDOW_EX_STYLE
WINDOW_STYLE
CreatePopupMenu
AppendMenu
TrackPopupMenu
DestroyMenu
MENU_ITEM_FLAGS
TRACK_POPUP_MENU_FLAGS
WM_LBUTTONUP
WM_RBUTTONUP
WM_CONTEXTMENU
WM_COMMAND
WM_DESTROY
WM_CLOSE
